description: This file contains React hooks for subscribing to real-time database changes via Supabase channels. It defines a generic hook `useRealtime` to manage subscriptions, along with specialized hooks `useResourcesRealtime` and `useNotificationsRealtime` for specific tables 'resources' and 'notifications'. The hooks handle lifecycle events, callbacks, and status management.

methods.name: useRealtime(subscriptions = [], channelName = 'app-realtime')
methods.description: A React hook that subscribes to specified Postgres changes via a Supabase channel. It manages lifecycle, status, and error handling, executing provided callback handlers for each event.

methods.name: useResourcesRealtime({ onInsert, onUpdate, onDelete, filter } = {})
methods.description: A specialized React hook that subscribes to real-time changes in the 'resources' table, providing onInsert, onUpdate, and onDelete callbacks.

methods.name: useNotificationsRealtime({ onInsert, onUpdate, onDelete, filter } = {})
methods.description: A specialized React hook for real-time subscriptions to the 'notifications' table, with callbacks for insert, update, and delete events.

ctags.name: useNotificationsRealtime
ctags.pattern: /^export function useNotificationsRealtime({ onInsert, onUpdate, onDelete, filter } = {}) {$/

ctags.name: useResourcesRealtime
ctags.pattern: /^export function useResourcesRealtime({ onInsert, onUpdate, onDelete, filter } = {}) {$/
